Event odds: Polymarket SpaceX US carrier 13% by mid-2027 / 34.5% by end-2027 (thin, ~$15k, cross-check only); Fed cut by March 2027 14%. 7) Sources: ~half are company filings/releases and the brief-mandated peer pages (data); the discretionary ones are mostly in lane (Yahoo base-rate studies, Polymarket, FRED, FCC/Auction 107/AWS-3 history, new-entrant precedents).
